cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: I Started the Weirdness
cards.instruction: Hide that one casual choice caused the impossible situation while eagerly helping manage each new consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I'll feed the little demon. You get our curtains out of its mouth.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It appeared when you read that novelty mug aloud.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Those mugs say all sorts. I'll fetch crackers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It only eats words. It's chewing the lease.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll swap in the mug and save our deposit. No need to preserve every possible clue.

mechanism: A manages a word-eating demon through its pupil old kitchen priorities, using new food knowledge to destroy the incriminating mug while saving the lease.
confusable: Not simply blaming the object: A hides its casual reading as cause while helping at each stage.
comparison: Physical rescue versus saving valued documents by sacrificing evidence.
seedUse: D157 demon/mug reading/crackers/words/lease; replace curtains with recipe book for coherent food rule; S05 kitchen rescue habits.
